\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage[paperwidth=420pt,paperheight=560pt,textwidth=310pt,textheight=94pt,top=42pt]{geometry}
\usepackage{dirtreex}
\pagestyle{empty}\raggedbottom

\makeatletter
\newcount\SDbefore \newcount\SDbegin \newcount\SDhbox \newcount\SDvbox
\newcount\SDformatted \newcount\SDpicture \newcount\SDmutations
\newwrite\SDnodes \immediate\openout\SDnodes=\jobname.nodes
\newwrite\SDtails \immediate\openout\SDtails=\jobname.tails
\newwrite\SDevents \immediate\openout\SDevents=\jobname.events
\newwrite\SDbounds \immediate\openout\SDbounds=\jobname.bounds
\newmarks\SDmarks
\everyhbox\expandafter{\the\everyhbox\global\advance\SDhbox by1}
\everyvbox\expandafter{\the\everyvbox\global\advance\SDvbox by1}
\let\SDformat\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{%
  \global\advance\SDformatted by1
  \protected@write\SDnodes{}{ENTRY \the\dte@tnum:#1}%
  \SDformat{#1}}
\let\SDrender\dte@render@tree
\def\dte@render@tree{%
  \marks\SDmarks{FIRST}\SDrender
  \marks\SDmarks{LAST}\protected@write\SDtails{}{TAIL \the\dte@tnum}}
\def\SDcounts{\the\SDbefore/\the\SDbegin/\the\SDhbox/\the\SDvbox}
\ifdefined\dte@set@firstmin
  \let\SDsetfirst\dte@set@firstmin
  \def\dte@set@firstmin#1#2{%
    \edef\SDsaved{\SDcounts}%
    \SDsetfirst{#1}{#2}%
    \edef\SDnow{\SDcounts}%
    \ifx\SDsaved\SDnow\else\errmessage{Depth refresh re-executed hooks}\fi
    \typeout{SD-BUDGET natural=#1;depth=#2;cap=\the\splitmaxdepth;minimum=\dte@firstminht}}
\fi
\let\SDsplit\dte@splitfirst
\def\dte@splitfirst#1{\SDsplit#1%
  \typeout{SD-SPLIT min=\dte@minht;target=\the\dte@availht;depth=\the\splitmaxdepth;badness=\the\badness}}
\def\SDstate{\the\splitmaxdepth/\the\baselineskip/\the\parskip/\the\parfillskip/\f@size/\f@family}
\newif\ifSDarmed \newif\ifSDouterpara
\def\SDmutation{}
\AddToHook{para/before}{\SDouterparafalse\ifinner\else\ifSDarmed
  \SDouterparatrue\global\advance\SDbefore by1
  \SDmutation
\fi\fi}
\AddToHook{para/begin}{\ifSDouterpara
  \global\advance\SDbegin by1
  \relax
\fi}
\tikzset{every picture/.append style={execute at end picture={%
  \global\advance\SDpicture by1
  \protected@write\SDevents{}{PICTURE}%
  \protected@write\SDbounds{}{BOUNDS \the\dimexpr\pgf@picmaxy-\pgf@picminy\relax}}}}
\AtEndDocument{\typeout{SD-COUNTS before=\the\SDbefore;begin=\the\SDbegin;hbox=\the\SDhbox;vbox=\the\SDvbox;format=\the\SDformatted;picture=\the\SDpicture;mutations=\the\SDmutations}}
\makeatother
\def\SDmutation{\global\advance\SDmutations by1\relax\splitmaxdepth=0pt\relax}

\tracingoutput=1\showboxbreadth=1000\showboxdepth=100
\begin{document}
\noindent PREFIX\par
\begingroup
\splitmaxdepth=\maxdimen\relax
\SDarmedtrue
\makeatletter\edef\SDouter{\SDstate}\makeatother
\begin{dirtreex}[box={margin={6pt,6pt,6pt,6pt}}]
\dir{R000}{C000L1\\C000L2\\C000L3\\C000L4\\C000L5\\C000L6}{
\file{R001}{C001}
\file{R002}{C002}
\file{R003}{C003}
\file{R004}{C004}
}
\end{dirtreex}
\SDarmedfalse
\makeatletter\edef\SDafter{\SDstate}\ifx\SDouter\SDafter\else\errmessage{Outer state changed}\fi\makeatother
\endgroup
\end{document}
